```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
```

## Method

This paragraph is body text before anything else, so the document has at
least one ordinary portrait page ahead of the rotated table. With
`numbered-lines: true` set (a live apaquarto option; journals routinely
require it under review), this page should keep its line numbers too --
apatablelandscape.lua's own two closers must carry `<w:lnNumType>`
themselves, because docxlinenumber.lua appends its
OWN numbering closer only once, at the very end of the document, and a
`sectPr` governs content back to the PREVIOUS closer -- so without this,
everything before and including a rotated table would silently lose its
line numbers, the same shape of defect as Quarto's own `.landscape`
handling.

@tbl-wide is wide enough that apaTables' layout ladder rotates it onto a
landscape page rather than shrinking its type (rotate before shrink).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-wide
#| tbl-cap: "Motor Trend Car Road Tests: Correlations"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars))
```

This paragraph is body text after the rotated table.
